name: generated-project
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm test

# {{name}}

A deterministic Dynamo project. Run `npm test`. Source is generated without executing hooks or downloading code. Review before deployment.

import argparse

def greet(name):
    return "Hello " + name

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("name", nargs="?", default="world")
    print(greet(parser.parse_args().name))
